title: PhD Programs, Fall 2027 Admission
about: Khalifa University's postgraduate admissions for Fall 2027 are open for PhD programs only; applications are accepted until 1 March 2027. Admitted applicants are normally notified by email within eight weeks of the deadline.
requirements: Direct PhD applicants: bachelor's CGPA of at least 3.5/4.0 and a GRE Quantitative score of at least 150 taken at a test center
Applicants holding a master's degree: master's CGPA of at least 3.25
